mainEntity.name: What is Connected TV (CTV) advertising?

acceptedAnswer.text: Connected TV advertising delivers video ads through internet-connected television devices—Smart TVs, Roku, Apple TV, Amazon Fire Stick, and gaming consoles. Ads appear within streaming content on platforms like Sportsnet+, CTV, Crave, Amazon Prime Video, and more, combining the premium big-screen experience of traditional TV with digital-level targeting and measurement.

mainEntity.name: Which streaming platforms can you advertise on?

acceptedAnswer.text: We place ads across all major Canadian and North American streaming platforms including Sportsnet+, TSN Direct, CTV, Crave, Amazon Prime Video, HGTV, Discovery+, YouTube TV, Hulu, Paramount+, and many more. Our network partnerships give you access to premium inventory across sports, entertainment, news, and lifestyle content.

mainEntity.name: How is CTV different from traditional TV advertising?

acceptedAnswer.text: CTV offers precise audience targeting based on demographics, interests, geography, and behavior—something traditional linear TV can't match. You also get real-time performance data, completion rate tracking, and cross-device attribution. CTV reaches the growing cord-cutter audience that traditional TV misses entirely.

mainEntity.name: What video ad formats are available?

acceptedAnswer.text: We support pre-roll (before content), mid-roll (during content), outstream (within article content), vertical video (mobile-optimized), and interactive overlays. Ad lengths range from 6-second bumpers to 30-second spots. All formats are non-skippable on most CTV platforms, ensuring full message delivery.

mainEntity.name: How do you measure CTV campaign performance?

acceptedAnswer.text: We track video completion rates, reach and frequency, brand lift, website visit attribution, and cross-device conversions. Our reporting dashboards provide real-time insights so you can see exactly how your campaigns perform and optimize in-flight for maximum ROI.

mainEntity.name: What budget do I need for a CTV campaign?

acceptedAnswer.text: CTV campaigns can be tailored to a range of budgets. Unlike traditional TV which requires large upfront commitments, CTV allows for more flexible spending with CPM-based pricing. We recommend a minimum 4-week flight to build meaningful reach and frequency, and we'll optimize your budget allocation across platforms for the best results.
